text: The art exhibition's theme revolves around urban life and its relentless pace. To complement the visual art pieces, a playlist with hip-hop tracks will play in the background, incorporating the genre's characteristic beats and lyrical flow to echo the energetic and often gritty atmosphere of city living. The rhythmic cadence of the verses mirrors the staccato rhythm of traffic and footsteps, while the heavy basslines resonate with the deep, vibrating hum of subway trains beneath the pavement. The raw, unfiltered storytelling typical of hip-hop adds a layer of narrative depth, highlighting the struggles and triumphs of individuals navigating the concrete jungle. This auditory backdrop transforms the gallery space into a dynamic urban landscape, where the visual art and the music converge to create an immersive experience that captures the pulse of the metropolis.
